meta.fictional: Fictional sample data. Harbourline Studio Ltd and everyone in it are invented.
rules: Books are in GBP. USDC accounts carry their USDC and are revalued to GBP at each month end (6510 Exchange gain or loss).

UK staff are paid in GBP terms: PAYE, National Insurance and pensions are worked in pounds; the net leaves the Treasury in USDC, to the person's Safe at the day's rate or to their bank in pounds through Bridge (USDC sent includes Bridge's fee).
Contractors abroad are paid in USDC: Sofia Lindqvist by a pay agreement she collects monthly (never in a run); Marta Kowalczyk and Studio Varga by invoice.
One payroll run a month on the top department, Harbourline: one command, one approval by whoever wears the Harbourline hat, one payment per payslip, each with a proof that commits to the payslip.

UK customers are invoiced in GBP and pay by bank transfer to Harbourline's Bridge bank details (RF reference on the invoice); the money lands in the Treasury as USDC. Three older customers pay into Barclays (Fernhill switched to the Bridge details in January 2026). US customers on Capxul are invoiced in USD and pay USDC from their own Safe; Copperleaf paid at the request's pay link.
PAYE, NI, VAT and pensions are paid from the ordinary Barclays account, which is topped up from the Treasury by bank payout to Harbourline itself.
Two Safes: the Treasury (budgets pay from it) and the Reserve Safe (the rounds' money; it moves only by Board proposal).
Department budgets are per calendar quarter in USDC; allowances are per month. A team's budget is carved from Harbourline's.
Document hashes are SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the advice (sorted keys); the app can re-hash `payments[].proof.advice` to verify `documentHash`.

turns.text: Why is Engineering already at 44% of its budget this quarter?

lookedAt.command: capxul org department show engineering --org harbourline
lookedAt.result: Engineering: 65,000.00 USDC this quarter, 23,578.44 spent, 4,800.00 committed, 36,621.56 left

turns.text: Engineering has spent 23,578.44 and committed 4,800.00 of its 65,000.00 USDC for October to December. Most of it is Sofia Lindqvist (9,600.00), Marta Kowalczyk (9,600.00), Kestrel Cloud Ltd (3,940.87). The committed part is Sofia Lindqvist's December collection under her pay agreement: it is already promised, so I count it. At this pace Engineering ends the quarter with about 32,023.76 left. If you want more room for the two January hires, the Board needs to raise Harbourline first (you proposed that this morning as sp_0194); then you can raise Engineering yourself, because you wear the hat above it.
We need five more seats for the January hires.

lookedAt.result: 14 of 20 seats in use, 1 invitation open, 10.00 USDC a seat

lookedAt.command: capxul org allowance get capxul --org harbourline
lookedAt.result: Capxul allowance: 100.00 of 200.00 USDC left this month

turns.text: You have 5 seats free once Owen Grady accepts, so five more would leave room for the January starters and a spare. Five seats cost 50.00 USDC, once. You wear People and hold the Capxul allowance, which has 100.00 USDC left this month, so you can pay for them yourself. I've prepared it; it needs your approval.

handover.command: capxul org seats buy 5 --org harbourline --from capxul
handover.note: Kwame chose Not now: the January offers are not signed yet.

turns.text: Not yet, let's wait until the offers are signed.
Fine. I've left it unsigned; nothing was bought. Ask me again when the offers are back.
Hannah said her October pay never arrived.

lookedAt.command: capxul org payroll run get HR-PRUN-2026-00010 --org harbourline
lookedAt.result: HR-PRUN-2026-00010: paid 30 Oct, one payslip in money waiting
Money waiting for hannah.cole@gmail.com: claimed 4 Nov 09:12

turns.text: Her pay waited for her because she had no Capxul account yet: 1,930.39 USDC (£1,521.72 net for 12 to 31 October) went into money waiting on 30 October, and Capxul emailed her. She set up her account this morning and claimed it at 09:12, so it is in her Safe now. Nothing more to do. Her November pay will go straight to her Safe.
Pay Brightfield's rent today.

lookedAt.command: capxul org doc list purchase-invoice --filter supplier="Brightfield Workspace Ltd" --filter status=Unpaid
capxul bank pay contact 5040 --org harbourline --account bacc_brightfield --from operations --quote

turns.text: November's rent is ACC-PINV-2026-00122 (their BW-2026-1107), £5,040.00 including VAT, due on the 15th. I got a quote: 6,392.08 USDC leaves the Treasury from Operations and Brightfield's NatWest account ending 2291 receives exactly £5,040.00 by Faster Payments; Bridge's fee is 4.08 USDC. The quote holds for ten minutes. You wear the Operations hat, so the approval is yours.

handover.title: Pay Brightfield Workspace Ltd by bank
handover.command: capxul bank pay contact 5040 --org harbourline --account bacc_brightfield --from operations

turns.text: Can I have Harbourline's VAT summary for Q2?

lookedAt.command: capxul org fde guest list --org harbourline
lookedAt.result: Sam Hollis is a guest: his own dealings only

turns.text: I can only show you your own dealings with Harbourline: Hollis & Reed's 7 invoices and their payments, the latest paid by bank on 7 November and on its way to your Lloyds account. For the VAT summary, ask Kwame Mensah, who wears the Books hat; he can share it with you.
turns.refused: A guest's FDE reads nothing of the Organization's beyond the guest's own dealings.

turns.text: Take back the money for Jules, she wants paying by bank.

lookedAt.result: Money waiting for jules.marchetti@proton.me: 2,400.00 USDC since 2 Nov

turns.text: The 2,400.00 USDC for jules.marchetti@proton.me has waited since 2 November and nobody has claimed it. You wear the Design hat, which funded it, so you can take it back. The money returns to the Treasury, but Design's room for this quarter stays spent: taking it back does not give the room back. I've drafted the take-back. Once you save Jules's bank details I can quote a bank payout in euros or pounds.

handover.title: Take back money waiting for jules.marchetti@proton.me
handover.note: Priya is on leave until 13 Nov; Maya, who wears the Harbourline hat above Design, can also take it back.

turns.text: Move Kestrel Health to Negotiation and email Aisha the revised proposal.

lookedAt.result: Leo Brennan: Growth, Invoicing; not People

turns.text: I can't do that as you: changing a deal and sending email from the CRM needs the People hat, and you wear Growth and Invoicing. I've drafted both for Sam Whitfield, who wears People: the move to Negotiation and the email to Dr Aisha Rahman with Kestrel-proposal-v3.pdf. He'll see them in his approvals.

handover.title: For Sam Whitfield: move the deal and send the proposal
handover.command: capxul org crm deal move CRM-DEAL-2026-00019 Negotiation && capxul org crm email send CRM-DEAL-2026-00019 --subject "Kestrel patient portal: revised proposal" --body-file proposal-v3.md --confirm

turns.text: When's my next payslip, and how much leave do I have left?

lookedAt.result: Annual Leave 6.5, Sick Leave 1.5, Compassionate Leave 5

turns.text: Your next payslip is for November, paid on Monday 30 November, straight to your Safe now that you have one. Your October slip was £1,521.72 net for 12 to 31 October. You have 6.5 days of annual leave and 1.5 days of sick leave left this year. To book leave, tell me the dates or use Leave › New.
How much runway do we have?

lookedAt.command: capxul org doc get bank-account "Barclays Business"

lookedAt.result: Out 638,134.74 USDC, in 480,799.68 USDC over three months

turns.text: Cash is 2,395,914.69 USDC across the two Safes (about £1,891,095.46) plus £25,351.06 in Barclays. Over August to October, 212,711.58 USDC a month left the Treasury and 160,266.56 USDC a month came in from customers, so the net burn is about 52,445.02 USDC a month. On that pace the money lasts 45 months. The seed money sits in the Reserve Safe and only moves to the Treasury by Board proposal.
